Hi Tom / team —

Sharing the redaction checklist and a minimal sample schema below. I'll also drop a sanitized sample (sample_payloads_sanitized.csv) to the S3 path you provided once you confirm the upload details.

Redaction checklist (minimum):
- Remove/replace all direct identifiers: full names, emails, phone numbers.
- Replace user_id with a deterministic hash (prefix: user_<sha256>).
- Remove SSNs, credit card numbers, exact addresses (retain only city/state).
- Truncate any long free-text fields > 2k chars (keep a representative 200–500 char snippet).
- Replace exact timestamps with hour-level buckets (e.g., 2025-11-03T15:00Z -> 2025-11-03T15:00Z).

Minimal CSV schema (columns):
- user_id
- prompt_text
- context_tokens_count
- routing_key
- user_locale
- created_at_hour
- expected_label (optional, for eval set)

Example row (sanitized):
user_a3f9b2, "How do I change my billing address?", 12, "billing", "en-US", "2025-11-03T15:00Z", "Update billing address steps"

Load test template:
- Burst: 50 RPS for 2 minutes
- Steady-state: 10 RPS for 20 minutes
- Concurrency: 10 concurrent requests
- Payload mix: 70% short prompts (<= 50 tokens), 30% long prompts (<= 300 tokens)

Attachments: sample_payloads.zip (contains schema + 1k anonymized rows), redaction_checklist.txt

If that looks good, we'll provision an S3 prefix with write permissions for your security team to upload the sanitized CSV. Let me know the S3 path and preferred method (pre-signed upload or cross-account bucket).

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
